gloss: to publish; to post; to carry (an article)

definitions.gloss: to publish; to post; to carry (an article)
definitions.explanation: To print or display content in a newspaper, magazine, website, or other media. Used for articles, advertisements, photos, and other published material.

examples.japanese: {記事|きじ}を{掲載|けいさい}する。
{新聞|しんぶん}に{広告|こうこく}が{掲載|けいさい}された。
examples.english: An advertisement was published in the newspaper.

examples.japanese: このウェブサイトに{掲載|けいさい}されている{情報|じょうほう}は{最新|さいしん}のものです。
examples.english: The information posted on this website is the most current.

notes: A formal word commonly used in written contexts, news, and official communication. Common collocations: {記事|きじ}を{掲載|けいさい}する (to publish an article), {写真|しゃしん}を{掲載|けいさい}する (to publish a photo), {広告|こうこく}を{掲載|けいさい}する (to carry an advertisement). The noun form {掲載|けいさい} can also be used on its own: {掲載|けいさい}{許可|きょか} (permission to publish).
